about_the_game:
[Time Sticker]: A Healing Idle Game Where Time Becomes a Reward

Feeling tense from fast-paced games? Try this lightweight idle game that "trades time for joy". — Once you open the game, an exquisite clock starts ticking quietly. All you need to do is let it stay by your side, automatically accumulating points every second.

Earn Points by Idling: No operations required — the clock automatically generates points every second, even when running in the background;

Unlock Packs: Use points to buy "Sticker Packs" and "Dial Packs" — each type holds unique surprises;

Collect Rare Items: Nearly a hundred stickers and dials are waiting for you to collect, from minimalist to gorgeous special effects, to create your one-of-a-kind dream clock
